note: Unofficial practice templates written for this project. They are not affiliated with any company and do not reproduce any company's real interview.

templates.title: AI Engineer
templates.jd: AI Engineer. Build and ship LLM-powered features: retrieval pipelines (RAG), prompt and tool design, evaluation harnesses and monitoring. Own services in production on a cloud platform. Requirements: strong Python, experience with APIs and databases, hands-on LLM application work, testing and evaluation habits, clear communication with product and design.

templates.title: Machine Learning Engineer
templates.jd: Machine Learning Engineer. Train, evaluate and deploy models. Build data and feature pipelines, track experiments, monitor drift and quality in production. Requirements: Python, scikit-learn or PyTorch, solid statistics and model-evaluation fundamentals, SQL, experience shipping models behind an API.

templates.title: Software Engineer (SDE)
templates.jd: Software Engineer. Design, build and maintain services and features. Write clean, tested code, review others' work and take part in on-call. Requirements: data structures and algorithms fundamentals, one backend language, SQL and API design, version control and testing, ability to explain trade-offs.

templates.title: Backend Developer (Python)
templates.jd: Backend Developer using Python. Build REST APIs and background jobs, model data in PostgreSQL, add caching and queues, and keep services reliable. Requirements: FastAPI, Django or Flask, SQL tuning, async or worker-based processing, Docker, logging and monitoring.

templates.title: Backend Developer (Java)
templates.jd: Backend Developer using Java. Build Spring Boot microservices, design REST and messaging interfaces, work with relational databases and keep systems observable. Requirements: Java collections and concurrency, Spring, JPA or SQL, unit and integration testing, basic cloud and CI/CD knowledge.

templates.title: Frontend Developer (React)
templates.jd: Frontend Developer using React. Build accessible, fast interfaces, manage state and data fetching, and work with designers and backend engineers. Requirements: JavaScript or TypeScript, React hooks and rendering behaviour, CSS layout, browser performance basics, testing, accessibility.

templates.title: Full-Stack Developer
templates.jd: Full-Stack Developer. Own features from database to user interface. Requirements: JavaScript or TypeScript on both ends, a web framework, SQL or document databases, authentication and API design, deployment basics, and the ability to balance speed with quality.

templates.title: Data Engineer
templates.jd: Data Engineer. Build reliable batch and streaming pipelines, model warehouse tables and keep data quality high. Requirements: SQL, Python, an orchestrator such as Airflow, warehouse concepts, incremental loads and idempotency, monitoring and data testing.

templates.title: DevOps / SRE
templates.jd: DevOps or Site Reliability Engineer. Automate delivery, run services reliably and respond to incidents. Requirements: Linux, containers and Kubernetes basics, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring and alerting, incident handling and post-mortems.

templates.title: Campus round: IT services company (fresher)
templates.jd: Entry-level software role in an IT services company. Expect questions on programming fundamentals, object-oriented concepts, basic SQL, your final-year or internship project, and teamwork. Requirements: any one programming language, data structures basics, willingness to learn, clear communication. (Unofficial practice round.)

templates.title: Product-startup engineering round
templates.jd: Engineer at an early-stage product startup. Expect questions on shipping quickly with limited resources, owning problems end to end, making trade-offs, debugging production issues and working directly with founders. Requirements: strong in one stack, comfortable with ambiguity, evidence of building and shipping real projects. (Unofficial practice round.)

templates.title: Large-tech style: fundamentals + design
templates.jd: Software engineer at a large technology company. Expect probing questions on data structures and complexity, system design at scale, handling failure, and collaboration at scale. Requirements: strong fundamentals, ability to reason about trade-offs aloud, structured communication. (Unofficial practice round.)

templates.title: Internship interview (engineering)
templates.jd: Engineering intern. Expect questions about your projects, what you learned, how you work in a team, how you handle deadlines and feedback, and why you want this internship. Requirements: curiosity, one or two real projects, basic programming skills, communication and reliability.

templates.title: Python fundamentals
templates.jd: Role focused on Python. Expect questions on data types and mutability, comprehensions and generators, decorators, exceptions, the GIL and concurrency, virtual environments and packaging, and writing testable code.

templates.title: SQL and databases
templates.jd: Role focused on SQL and databases. Expect questions on joins, aggregation and window functions, indexing and query plans, transactions and isolation, normalisation versus denormalisation, and diagnosing a slow query.

templates.title: LLM applications and RAG
templates.jd: Role focused on LLM applications. Expect questions on retrieval-augmented generation, chunking and embeddings, reranking, evaluating answer quality and faithfulness, prompt injection and safety, latency and cost control, and monitoring in production.

templates.title: System design basics
templates.jd: Role with a system-design round. Expect to clarify requirements, estimate scale, choose storage and APIs, add caching and queues, discuss consistency and availability, and explain trade-offs and failure handling for a familiar product such as a URL shortener or chat service.

templates.title: Testing, Git and code quality
templates.jd: Role that values engineering practice. Expect questions on writing and structuring tests, handling flaky tests, code review habits, branching and merge conflicts, refactoring safely and keeping a codebase maintainable.
